test_title: PYST 28: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 4 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Why do the teachers at Shikshayatan believe that learning can be done by the playway method?

options.text: Because they feel learning can be made easy through cartoons
Because they feel learning can be done only in the class room
Because they feel learning can be made interesting and enjoyable
Because they feel learning can be done in the play ground

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 3) **"Because they feel learning can be made interesting and enjoyable" is the **correct answer** as it aligns with the information provided in the passage.
 
• **The teachers at Shikshayatan emphasize** the idea that learning is a form of play and demonstrate that learning can be made interesting and enjoyable for the students. 
 
• **The teachers aim **to prove that learning does not have to be dull or monotonous but can be an enjoyable experience.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: *'Because they feel learning can be made interesting and enjoyable'.*
